name: Timeline
purpose: Presents a chronologically ordered list of events with markers and timestamps.

items.description: Array of { id, title, description?, time? } events in order.

emptyLabel.description: Text shown when items is empty.

antiPatterns: Do not render events out of chronological order.
Do not use a timeline for navigation between pages.

a11y.focus: Items are not focusable unless they contain actions.
a11y.labeling: Ordered list semantics convey chronology; timestamps use time elements.

responsive.strategy: Vertical rail at all breakpoints; indentation follows inline direction.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Direction inherits from document lang/dir.
